description: Search Teppek's live listings by MEANING (semantic search backed by a multilingual embedding index). Use it when the user describes what they want in natural language rather than exact keywords — e.g. "outdoor jobs that don't need a degree", "affordable family cars that are good in snow", "a cosy studio close to the university". Returns the closest-matching ACTIVE listings ranked by semantic similarity (each item carries a `score`). Complements search_listings: prefer search_listings for precise keyword/role/country/category/price filtering and exact counts; prefer semantic_search when meaning, synonyms, or fuzzy intent matter more than literal terms. Optional `vertical` narrows to career/real_estate/vehicle/service. Returns at most 20 results per call. Requires the user to be connected to Teppek (authenticated): an anonymous call returns an AUTH_REQUIRED error with an authorize_url.

country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "de", "gb", "us") to rank only listings of that country. Known for imported jobs, US vehicles and service listings; listings posted directly on Teppek have no country, so for a city use `near` instead. Example: "de".

exclude.description: Words or phrases the user does NOT want. A listing whose title or description contains one is dropped, unless the word is negated there ("no degree required" is kept when excluding "degree"). Example for "jobs that do not need a degree": query "entry-level job with training", exclude ["degree", "diploma", "bachelor", "PhD"].

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1-20. Default 20. Example: 10.

near.description: Only listings within radius_km of this point; resolve the city to coordinates first. Ranking by meaning happens inside that area, so "waiter in Istanbul" returns Istanbul listings only. Each result then carries distance_km. Example: { "lat": 41.01, "lon": 28.98, "radius_km": 30 }.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres, up to 200. Default 25. Example: 30.

query.description: What the user wants, described positively, without the place (e.g. "waiter job in a restaurant", "entry-level job with on-the-job training", "cosy family flat near a park"). Matched by MEANING, not exact keywords. Put the place in `near` or `country`, not here: a city name in the query does not restrict results. Negations ("no degree", "not a chef") are NOT understood here — phrase the wish positively and put unwanted words in `exclude`.

vertical.description: Optional vertical filter (career | real_estate | vehicle | service) applied server-side to the active listings before they are returned.

name: semantic_search
